schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE products (product_id NUMBER PRIMARY KEY, product_name VARCHAR2(100), category_code VARCHAR2(20));
CREATE TABLE sales_fact (product_id NUMBER, sale_qty NUMBER, sale_date DATE);
original_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, s.sale_qty
FROM products p, sales_fact s
WHERE p.product_id = s.product_id
  AND p.category_code = 'CAT_10'
  AND s.sale_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ OPT_ESTIMATE(TABLE s ROWS=45000) LEADING(s p) USE_HASH(p) */ p.product_id, p.product_name, s.sale_qty
FROM products p, sales_fact s
WHERE p.product_id = s.product_id
  AND p.category_code = :b1
  AND s.sale_date = :b2

diagnosis.risk_notes: OPT_ESTIMATE 보정값은 데이터 분포가 바뀌면 어긋날 수 있어 통계 수집 주기와 함께 관리해야 한다.
